license_required.quote: No person may practice architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering in this state unless the person has been duly registered, is exempt under s. 443.14 or has in effect a permit under s. 443.10 (1) (d).

exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering (Engineer-in-Training) Examination
exams.notes: Required for engineer-in-training certification; written examination in fundamental engineering subjects. Also required as part of the path to professional engineer registration.
exams.jurisdiction: state (professional engineer section of the examining board)
exams.quote: Written examinations shall be required of every applicant for certification as engineer-in-training.

exams.name: Professional Engineer Examination
exams.notes: Written or written and oral examinations required for registration as a professional engineer.
exams.jurisdiction: state (professional engineer section of the examining board)
exams.quote: Written or written and oral examinations shall be required of every applicant for registration as an architect or a professional engineer.

interval_years.quote: Engineer, professional: August 1 of each even-numbered year.

required.quote: Each section of the examining board may establish continuing education requirements for renewal of a credential issued by that section under this chapter.

available.quote: The appropriate section of the examining board may, upon application and the payment of the required fee, grant a certificate of registration as an architect, as a landscape architect, or as a professional engineer to any person who holds an unexpired certificate of similar registration issued to the person by the proper authority in any state or territory or possession of the United States or in any country in which the requirements for the registration of architects, landscape architects, or professional engineers are of a standard not lower than specified in this chapter.

requirements.value: Must hold an unexpired certificate of similar registration from another state, territory, possession of the United States, or qualifying country with standards not lower than Wisconsin's requirements. Payment of required fee required.
requirements.quote: grant a certificate of registration as an architect, as a landscape architect, or as a professional engineer to any person who holds an unexpired certificate of similar registration issued to the person by the proper authority in any state or territory or possession of the United States or in any country in which the requirements for the registration of architects, landscape architects, or professional engineers are of a standard not lower than specified in this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The appropriate section of the examining board shall grant a certificate of registration upon payment of the registration fee to any applicant who, in the opinion of the appropriate section, has satisfactorily met all the applicable requirements of this chapter. The certificate shall authorize the practice of architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering, as appropriate.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may practice architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering in this state unless the person has been duly registered, is exempt under s. 443.14 or has in effect a permit under s. 443.10 (1) (d).

title_protection.quote: no person may offer to practice architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering or use in connection with the person's name or otherwise assume, use or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is an architect, landscape architect, or professional engineer or advertise to furnish architectural, landscape architectural, or professional engineering services unless the person has been duly registered or has in effect a permit under s. 443.10 (1) (d).

scope_protection.quote: No person may practice architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering in this state unless the person has been duly registered, is exempt under s. 443.14 or has in effect a permit under s. 443.10 (1) (d).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate of registration or a certificate of record
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate of registration or a certificate of record.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or impressing seal upon documents not prepared by the registrant or knowingly permitting seal to be used by another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing or impressing his or her seal or stamp upon documents not prepared by him or her or under his or her control or knowingly permitting his or her seal or stamp to be used by any other person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting unauthorized practice of architecture or professional engineering
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or abetting the unauthorized practice of architecture or professional engineering by persons not registered under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of professional engineering
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of architecture as a registered architect, of landscape architecture as a registered landscape architect or of professional engineering as a registered professional engineer, or in the professional activity of a holder of a certificate of record as engineer-in-training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of rules of professional conduct adopted by the examining board section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the rules of professional conduct adopted and promulgated by that section of the examining board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or adjudication of mental incompetency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322 and 111.335, or adjudication of mental incompetency by a court of competent jurisdiction, a certified copy of the record of conviction or adjudication of incompetency to be conclusive evidence of such conviction or incompetency.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No firm, partnership, or corporation may engage in the practice of or offer to practice professional engineering in this state, or use in connection with its name, or otherwise assume, use or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that it is engaged in the practice of professional engineering, nor may it advertise or offer to furnish a professional engineering service, unless the firm, partnership, or corporation has complied with this chapter.

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional engineering includes any professional service requiring the application of engineering principles and data, in which the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned and involved, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or responsible supervision of construction, alteration, or operation, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, projects, bridges, plants and buildings, machines, equipment, processes and works.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional engineering" includes any professional service requiring the application of engineering principles and data, in which the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned and involved, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or responsible supervision of construction, alteration, or operation, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, projects, bridges, plants and buildings, machines, equipment, processes and works.

methods_authorized.quote: such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or responsible supervision of construction, alteration, or operation, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, projects, bridges, plants and buildings, machines, equipment, processes and works.

covers_land_surveying.quote: examining board means the examining board of architects, landscape architects, professional engineers, designers, professional land surveyors, and registered interior designers.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer-in-training" means a person who is a graduate in an engineering curriculum of 4 years or more from a school or college approved by the professional engineer section of the examining board as of satisfactory standing... and who has been granted a certificate of record by the professional engineer section stating that the person has successfully passed this portion of the professional examinations.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible supervision of construction" means a professional service, as distinguished from superintending of construction, and means the performance, or the supervision thereof, of reasonable and ordinary on-site observations to determine that the construction is in substantial compliance with the approved drawings, plans and specifications.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: All final drawings, specifications, plans, reports, or other engineering papers or documents involving the practice of professional engineering, prepared for the use of a firm, partnership, or corporation, for delivery by it to any person, or for public record within the state shall be dated and bear the signature and seal of the professional engineer who was in responsible charge of their preparation.

seal_document_types.quote: All final drawings, specifications, plans, reports, or other engineering papers or documents involving the practice of professional engineering, prepared for the use of a firm, partnership, or corporation, for delivery by it to any person, or for public record within the state shall be dated and bear the signature and seal of the professional engineer who was in responsible charge of their preparation.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: The practice of professional engineering pertaining to the internal operations of a firm, partnership, or corporation may be performed by employees if the professional engineering services are performed by or under the direct supervision of professional engineers registered under this chapter, or persons exempt from registration under s. 443.14.

value: Employees of registered professional engineers not in responsible charge
Federal government officers and employees practicing professional engineering for the federal government
Public service company and its regular employees where services are in connection with regulated facilities
Any person who practices professional engineering exclusively as a regular employee of a private company if a registered PE is in responsible charge
Person engaged in manufacture of a product or unit including laboratory research affiliates
Contractors, subcontractors, or construction material or equipment suppliers performing historical trade activities
Manufacturers or material or equipment suppliers performing engineering in design, assembly, manufacture, sale or installation of their products
Professional engineer collecting, investigating, or interpreting data relating to soil, rock, groundwater, etc.
Person practicing professional geology, hydrology, or soil science who also practices professional engineering as part of those practices
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The following persons, while practicing within the scope of their respective exemptions, shall be exempt from this chapter

retired_status_license_available.quote: Each section of the examining board shall promulgate rules to do all of the following: Allow the holder of a credential under this chapter who is at least 65 years of age or has actively maintained that credential for at least 20 years... to apply to the board to classify that credential as retired status.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Federal government officers and employees practicing engineering in official capacity
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Officers and employees of the federal government while engaged within this state in the practice of architecture, landscape architecture or professional engineering for the federal government.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Contractors executing work designed by a licensed engineer (construction execution only)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: contractors, subcontractors or construction material or equipment suppliers are not required to register under this chapter to perform or undertake those activities which historically and customarily have been performed by them in their respective trades and specialties

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Building trades workers, craft workers, and construction superintendents/supervisors/inspectors performing customary duties
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: contractors, subcontractors or construction material or equipment suppliers are not required to register under this chapter to perform or undertake those activities which historically and customarily have been performed by them in their respective trades and specialties, including, but not limited to, the preparation and use of drawings, specifications or layouts within a construction firm or in construction operations, superintending of construction

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Employees or subordinates working under direct supervision of a licensed engineer
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An employee of a person holding a certificate of registration in professional engineering under s. 443.10 who is engaged in the practice of professional engineering and an employee of a person temporarily exempted from registration in professional engineering under this section, if the practice of the employee does not include responsible charge of professional engineering practice.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineers-in-training / engineer interns acting under supervision
Land surveyor interns
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An employee of a professional land surveyor, while doing surveying work under the supervision of the employer, if the employee is not in responsible charge of the practice of professional land surveying.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Teaching engineering, architectural, landscape architectural, or surveying courses at accredited institutions
Regulated transportation companies and public utilities (and their officers and employees) performing engineering for their own facilities
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A public service company and its regular employees acting in its behalf where the professional engineering services rendered are in connection with its facilities which are subject to regulation, supervision and control by a commission of this state or of the federal government.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of architecture by licensed architects and their subordinates
Engineering services incidental to the practice of geology by licensed geologists and their subordinates
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person who, while engaged in the practice of professional geology, hydrology or soil science as defined in s. 470.01 (2), (3) or (4), practices professional engineering, if the acts that involve the practice of professional engineering are also part of the practice of professional geology, hydrology or soil science.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
Manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporations performing engineering work incidental to their own products, systems, or services
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person engaged in the manufacture of a product or unit, including laboratory research affiliates of the person, where the services performed are the design, assembly, manufacture, sale or installation of that product or unit.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person who practices professional engineering, exclusively as a regular employee of a private company or corporation, by rendering to the company or corporation professional engineering services in connection with its operations, so long as the person is thus actually and exclusively employed and no longer, if the company or corporation has at least one professional engineer who is registered under this chapter in responsible charge of the company's or corporation's professional engineering work in this state.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The appropriate section of the examining board may, upon application and payment of the required fee, grant a permit to practice or to offer to practice architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering to a person who is not a resident of and has no established place of business in this state, or who has recently become a resident of this state, if the person holds an unexpired certificate of similar registration

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Real estate brokers or salespersons making appraisals and valuations of real estate
Alterations or repairs to buildings not affecting structural system or public health, safety, or welfare
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Nothing in this chapter prevents any person, firm or corporation from making repairs or interior alterations to buildings which do not affect health or safety.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Nothing in this chapter prevents any person from advertising and performing services, including consultation, investigation, evaluation, in connection with and making plans and specifications for, or supervising the erection, enlargement or alterations of any of the following buildings: Dwellings for single families, and outbuildings in connection with single-family dwellings

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Agricultural work not required to be of public record
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Buildings used exclusively for agricultural purposes.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Maintenance or placement of plant material not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Horticultural consultants and persons preparing planting plans for plant installations
Authorized designers of fire protection systems
Holders of temporary permits for engineering practice
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: No person may practice architecture, landscape architecture, or professional engineering in this state unless the person has been duly registered, is exempt under s. 443.14 or has in effect a permit under s. 443.10 (1) (d).

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The professional engineer section shall grant a certificate of authorization to a firm, partnership, or corporation complying with this subsection upon payment of the initial credential fee determined by the department under s. 440.03 (9) (a). This subsection does not apply to firms, partnerships, or corporations exempt under s. 443.14 (3) or (5).

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Government employees inspecting residential structures as part of official duties
Persons performing home inspections solely for lender construction monitoring
Property managers inspecting their own managed residential structures without separate compensation
Small public works projects below a specified expenditure threshold
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Nothing in this chapter prevents any person, firm or corporation from making plans and specifications for or supervising the erection, enlargement or alteration of any new building containing less than 50,000 cubic feet total volume

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Licensed geologists practicing geology (not required to hold engineer license)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person who, while engaged in the practice of professional geology, hydrology or soil science as defined in s. 470.01 (2), (3) or (4), practices professional engineering, if the acts that involve the practice of professional engineering are also part of the practice of professional geology, hydrology or soil science.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Persons with grandfathered or legacy licensure status in discontinued engineering branch titles
Boundary surveys on private land not intended as basis for engineering design
Professional engineers or engineer interns granted inactive status
Senior licensed professional engineers exempt from continuing education requirements
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any rules a section of the examining board promulgates under sub. (1) shall exempt a credential holder whose credential is classified as retired status under par. (a) from continuing education requirements.
